units.locator: Article 31. Additional guarantees provided to a municipal servant under the legislation of the City of Moscow
units.text: 1) additional monetary payments provided for by legislation of the City of Moscow;
units.label: Point 1 Part 2 Art. 31

units.locator: Article 31. Additional guarantees provided to a municipal servant under the legislation of the City of Moscow
units.text: 2) a free or subsidised health-resort voucher for annual paid leave, with payment of travel to and from the holiday destination, or corresponding compensation;
units.label: Point 2 Part 2 Art. 31

units.locator: Article 31. Additional guarantees provided to a municipal servant under the legislation of the City of Moscow
units.text: 3) additional professional education with retention of remuneration during training;
units.label: Point 3 Part 2 Art. 31

units.locator: Article 31. Additional guarantees provided to a municipal servant under the legislation of the City of Moscow
units.text: 4) a monthly pension supplement to an old-age insurance pension or a disability insurance pension for persons with Group I or II disability, awarded in accordance with Federal Law No. 400-FZ of 28 December 2013 “On Insurance Pensions” or awarded early in accordance with Law of the Russian Federation No. 1032-1 of 19 April 1991 “On Employment of the Population in the Russian Federation” (hereinafter, the pension supplement). The pension supplement is established where the person has a length of municipal service whose minimum duration for the relevant year is determined under Appendix 2 to Federal Law No. 166-FZ of 15 December 2001 “On State Pension Provision in the Russian Federation”. The supplement is set so that the total old-age insurance pension or disability insurance pension for persons with Group I or II disability and the supplement equals 55 percent of the municipal servant’s monthly remuneration in the last municipal service position held before reaching the age specified in Appendix 5 to the Federal Law “On Insurance Pensions”, or before dismissal from municipal service. The supplement increases by three percent of the municipal servant’s monthly remuneration for every full year of service exceeding the minimum municipal service duration prescribed by federal legislation for the relevant year; the total old-age insurance pension or disability insurance pension for persons with Group I or II disability and the supplement may not exceed 80 percent of the monthly remuneration taken into account when calculating the supplement. The conditions for awarding the supplement and the monthly remuneration used in its calculation are determined in the procedure established for state civil servants of the City of Moscow (hereinafter, state civil servants). The supplement is recalculated when the official salary for the corresponding municipal service position is increased centrally or the amount of the old-age insurance pension or disability insurance pension for persons with Group I or II disability changes;
units.label: Point 4 Part 2 Art. 31

units.locator: Article 31. Additional guarantees provided to a municipal servant under the legislation of the City of Moscow
units.text: 5) a lump-sum monetary incentive upon reaching 50 years of age and every five years thereafter, in amounts not exceeding two months’ remuneration for the municipal service position held;
units.label: Point 5 Part 2 Art. 31

units.locator: Article 31. Additional guarantees provided to a municipal servant under the legislation of the City of Moscow
units.text: 6) a lump-sum monetary incentive upon reaching 20 years of municipal service and every five years thereafter, in amounts not exceeding two months’ remuneration for the position held, provided that the servant has at least five years of municipal service in local self-government bodies in the City of Moscow;
units.label: Point 6 Part 2 Art. 31

units.locator: Article 31. Additional guarantees provided to a municipal servant under the legislation of the City of Moscow
units.text: 7) a monetary award paid once over the entire period of municipal service on removal from the position held and dismissal where the servant is entitled to an old-age insurance pension or a disability insurance pension for persons with Group I or II disability. The amount is calculated using the average monthly wage in the last municipal service position held before service terminated, multiplied by the number of full years of municipal service, but for no more than 10 years as of the date of termination. No payment is made to a municipal servant who previously received an analogous payment on leaving state civil service of the City of Moscow. A servant who previously received an analogous payment on leaving federal military service, federal law enforcement service, state civil service, state civil service in other constituent entities of the Russian Federation or municipal service in other constituent entities is paid in proportion to the number of full years respectively of state civil service in state bodies of the City of Moscow and municipal service in the City of Moscow in local self-government bodies and municipal bodies.
units.label: Point 7 Part 2 Art. 31

units.locator: Article 31. Additional guarantees provided to a municipal servant under the legislation of the City of Moscow
units.text: 3. The maximum total of a municipal servant’s old-age insurance pension or disability insurance pension for persons with Group I or II disability and pension supplement may not exceed the maximum total of an old-age insurance pension or a disability insurance pension for persons with Group I or II disability and the pension supplement for a state civil servant in the corresponding state civil service position.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 31

units.locator: Article 31. Additional guarantees provided to a municipal servant under the legislation of the City of Moscow
units.text: 4. Guarantees for a municipal servant established by Points 4 and 6 of Part 1 of Article 30 and Points 2 and 4 of Part 2 of this Article are provided to an extent not exceeding the corresponding guarantees for state civil servants holding positions in the corresponding groups of state civil service positions.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 31

units.locator: Article 31. Additional guarantees provided to a municipal servant under the legislation of the City of Moscow
units.text: 5. A municipal servant who retires from municipal service on an old-age insurance pension or a disability insurance pension for persons with Group I or II disability and is entitled to a pension supplement under Point 4 of Part 2 of this Article retains the guarantees provided for by Point 2 of Part 2 of this Article, to an extent not exceeding the corresponding guarantee for state civil servants.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 31

units.locator: Article 31. Additional guarantees provided to a municipal servant under the legislation of the City of Moscow
units.text: 6. The municipal servant’s family members or other persons who arranged the funeral are reimbursed funeral service expenses in the procedure and on the terms established for state civil servants.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 31

units.locator: Article 31. Additional guarantees provided to a municipal servant under the legislation of the City of Moscow
units.text: 7. The representative body determines the procedure for providing a municipal servant with the guarantees established by this Article.
units.label: Part 7 Art. 31

units.locator: Article 31. Additional guarantees provided to a municipal servant under the legislation of the City of Moscow
units.text: 8. Expenses associated with providing a municipal servant and their family members with the guarantees provided for by this Article are paid from the local budget.
units.label: Part 8 Art. 31

units.locator: Article 32. Pension provision for a municipal servant and members of their family
units.text: Article 32. Pension provision for a municipal servant and members of their family
units.label: Art. 32

units.locator: Article 32. Pension provision for a municipal servant and members of their family
units.text: 1. In pension provision, a municipal servant enjoys in full the rights of a state civil servant established by federal laws and laws of the City of Moscow.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 32

units.locator: Article 32. Pension provision for a municipal servant and members of their family
units.text: 2. A municipal servant’s state pension amount is determined in accordance with the correspondence between municipal service positions and state civil service positions established by this Law. The maximum municipal servant’s state pension may not exceed the maximum state pension for a state civil servant in the corresponding state civil service position.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 32

units.locator: Article 32. Pension provision for a municipal servant and members of their family
units.text: 3. If a municipal servant dies in connection with the performance of official duties, including after leaving municipal service, the deceased servant’s family members are entitled to a survivor’s pension according to the procedure determined by federal laws.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 32

units.locator: Article 32. Pension provision for a municipal servant and members of their family
units.text: 4. A municipal servant retires in the procedure established by federal law.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 32

units.locator: Article 33. Length of municipal service
units.text: Article 33. Length of municipal service
units.label: Art. 33

units.locator: Article 33. Length of municipal service
units.text: 1. The length (total duration) of municipal service includes periods of holding:
units.label: Part 1 Art. 33

units.locator: Article 33. Length of municipal service
units.text: 1) municipal service positions;
units.label: Point 1 Part 1 Art. 33

units.locator: Article 33. Length of municipal service
units.text: 2) municipal offices;
units.label: Point 2 Part 1 Art. 33

units.locator: Article 33. Length of municipal service
units.text: 3) state offices of the Russian Federation, state offices of the City of Moscow and state offices of other constituent entities of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 3 Part 1 Art. 33

units.locator: Article 33. Length of municipal service
units.text: 4) state civil service positions, military positions, and positions in other types of federal state service;
units.label: Point 4 Part 1 Art. 33

units.locator: Article 33. Length of municipal service
units.text: 5) other positions in accordance with federal laws.
units.label: Point 5 Part 1 Art. 33

units.locator: Article 33. Length of municipal service
units.text: 2. In addition to periods in the positions specified in Part 1 of this Article, the length of municipal service used to determine annual additional paid leave for length of service and other guarantees provided for by federal laws, laws of the City of Moscow and charters of municipal formations also includes (credits) periods in positions included (credited) in the length of state civil service under Federal Law No. 79-FZ of 27 July 2004 “On State Civil Service of the Russian Federation” and Law of the City of Moscow No. 11 of 17 May 2000 “On Periods of Service (Work) Taken into Account in Calculating the Length of State Civil Service of the City of Moscow for State Civil Servants of the City of Moscow”.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 33

units.locator: Article 33. Length of municipal service
units.text: 3. For awarding municipal servants a pension for length of service, the length of municipal service includes (credits), in addition to periods in the positions specified in Part 1 of this Article, other periods of employment in accordance with normative legal acts of the City of Moscow and municipal legal acts. Other periods of employment mean periods of work (service) in managerial and specialist positions in organisations where experience and knowledge needed to perform official duties in the municipal service positions held were acquired. The total duration of such other periods may not exceed 50 percent of the municipal servant’s existing length of municipal service and may not exceed five years overall.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 33

units.locator: Article 33. Length of municipal service
units.text: 4. Other periods of employment are included in a municipal servant’s length of municipal service by the municipal formation’s commission for calculating length of service (hereinafter, the service-length commission), established by the representative body.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 33

units.locator: Article 33. Length of municipal service
units.text: 5. The representative body determines the working procedure of the service-length commission.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 33

units.locator: Article 33. Length of municipal service
units.text: 6. Decisions of the service-length commission are binding on the local self-government body of the corresponding municipal formation from the date the commission adopts them.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 33

units.locator: Chapter 7. COMMENDATION OF A MUNICIPAL SERVANT.

units.locator: Article 34. Commendation of a municipal servant
units.text: Article 34. Commendation of a municipal servant
units.label: Art. 34

units.locator: Article 34. Commendation of a municipal servant
units.text: 1. A municipal servant may receive the following rewards for successful and conscientious performance of official duties, long and impeccable service, or performance of assignments of special importance and complexity:
units.label: Part 1 Art. 34

units.locator: Article 34. Commendation of a municipal servant
units.text: 1) a declaration of thanks with payment of a lump-sum monetary incentive;
units.label: Point 1 Part 1 Art. 34

units.locator: Article 34. Commendation of a municipal servant
units.text: 2) an honorary certificate of the local self-government body with payment of a lump-sum monetary incentive or presentation of a valuable gift;
units.label: Point 2 Part 1 Art. 34

units.locator: Article 34. Commendation of a municipal servant
units.text: 3) rewards by the Mayor of Moscow, the Government of Moscow or the Moscow City Duma, City of Moscow awards and honorary titles of the City of Moscow, in accordance with laws and other legal acts of the City of Moscow;
units.label: Point 3 Part 1 Art. 34

units.locator: Article 34. Commendation of a municipal servant
units.text: 4) honorary titles of the Russian Federation and distinctions, orders and medals of the Russian Federation in accordance with federal legislation;
units.label: Point 4 Part 1 Art. 34

units.locator: Article 34. Commendation of a municipal servant
units.text: 5) other rewards provided for by municipal legal acts.
units.label: Point 5 Part 1 Art. 34

units.locator: Article 34. Commendation of a municipal servant
units.text: 2. The employer’s representative (employer) decides on rewards for a municipal servant in the cases specified in Points 1, 2 and 5 of Part 1 of this Article. Decisions in the cases specified in Points 3 and 4 of Part 1 are made in accordance with federal legislation, laws and other normative legal acts of the City of Moscow.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 34

units.locator: Article 34. Commendation of a municipal servant
units.text: 3. The representative body decides on rewards for a municipal servant holding the position of head of administration under contract.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 34

units.locator: Article 35. Disciplinary liability of a municipal servant
units.text: Article 35. Disciplinary liability of a municipal servant
units.label: Art. 35

units.locator: Article 35. Disciplinary liability of a municipal servant
units.text: 1. For a disciplinary offence — culpable non-performance or improper performance by a municipal servant of their assigned official duties or a breach of labour discipline — the employer’s representative (employer) may impose the following disciplinary sanctions:
units.label: Part 1 Art. 35

units.locator: Article 35. Disciplinary liability of a municipal servant
units.text: 1) an admonition;
units.label: Point 1 Part 1 Art. 35

units.locator: Article 35. Disciplinary liability of a municipal servant
units.text: 2) a reprimand;
units.label: Point 2 Part 1 Art. 35

units.locator: Article 35. Disciplinary liability of a municipal servant
units.text: 3) dismissal from municipal service on the corresponding grounds provided for by federal legislation.
units.label: Point 3 Part 1 Art. 35

units.locator: Article 35. Disciplinary liability of a municipal servant
units.text: 2. A municipal servant who has committed a disciplinary offense may be temporarily suspended from official duties, for no more than one month, pending a decision on disciplinary liability, with retention of monetary remuneration. Such suspension from official duties is effected by a municipal legal act.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 35

units.locator: Article 35. Disciplinary liability of a municipal servant
units.text: 3. The procedure for imposing and lifting disciplinary sanctions is determined by labour legislation, except in cases provided for by the Federal Law “On Municipal Service in the Russian Federation”.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 35

units.locator: Article 35. Disciplinary liability of a municipal servant
units.text: 4. A disciplinary sanction may be challenged in the procedure established by federal legislation.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 35

units.locator: Article 35. Disciplinary liability of a municipal servant
units.text: 5. A municipal servant bears liability under federal legislation and laws of the City of Moscow for actions or inaction violating citizens’ rights and legitimate interests.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 35

units.locator: Article 35.1. Penalties for failure to comply with restrictions, prohibitions and requirements to prevent or settle conflicts of interest, and for failure to perform duties established for anti-corruption purposes
units.text: Article 35.1. Penalties for failure to comply with restrictions, prohibitions and requirements to prevent or settle conflicts of interest, and for failure to perform duties established for anti-corruption purposes
units.label: Art. 35.1

units.locator: Article 35.1. Penalties for failure to comply with restrictions, prohibitions and requirements to prevent or settle conflicts of interest, and for failure to perform duties established for anti-corruption purposes
units.text: 1. Failure by a municipal servant to comply with restrictions, prohibitions and requirements to prevent or resolve conflicts of interest, or to perform duties established for combating corruption by the Federal Law “On Municipal Service in the Russian Federation”, the Federal Law “On Combating Corruption”, other federal laws and this Law, results in the sanctions provided for by Article 35 of this Law.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 35.1

units.locator: Article 35.1. Penalties for failure to comply with restrictions, prohibitions and requirements to prevent or settle conflicts of interest, and for failure to perform duties established for anti-corruption purposes
units.text: 1.1. A municipal servant is exempt from liability for failure to comply with restrictions, prohibitions and requirements to prevent or resolve conflicts of interest, or to perform duties established by federal laws and this Law for combating corruption, if that failure is recognised as resulting from circumstances beyond the servant’s control in the procedure provided for by Parts 3–6 of Article 13 of the Federal Law “On Combating Corruption”.
units.label: Part 1.1 Art. 35.1

units.locator: Article 35.1. Penalties for failure to comply with restrictions, prohibitions and requirements to prevent or settle conflicts of interest, and for failure to perform duties established for anti-corruption purposes
units.text: 2. A municipal servant shall be dismissed from municipal service due to loss of trust in cases of offences established by Articles 16 and 17 of this Law.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 35.1

units.locator: Article 35.1. Penalties for failure to comply with restrictions, prohibitions and requirements to prevent or settle conflicts of interest, and for failure to perform duties established for anti-corruption purposes
units.text: 3. The employer’s representative (employer) imposes sanctions provided for by Articles 16, 17 and 35 of this Law in the procedure established by normative legal acts of the City of Moscow and/or municipal legal acts, on the basis of:
units.label: Part 3 Art. 35.1

units.locator: Article 35.1. Penalties for failure to comply with restrictions, prohibitions and requirements to prevent or settle conflicts of interest, and for failure to perform duties established for anti-corruption purposes
units.text: 1) a report on the results of a check conducted by the relevant local self-government body’s personnel service unit for preventing corruption and other offences, or by the authorised unit of the Administration of the President of the Russian Federation under Article 13.4 of the Federal Law “On Combating Corruption”;
units.label: Point 1 Part 3 Art. 35.1

units.locator: Article 35.1. Penalties for failure to comply with restrictions, prohibitions and requirements to prevent or settle conflicts of interest, and for failure to perform duties established for anti-corruption purposes
units.text: 2) a recommendation of the commission for resolving conflicts of interest where the report on the check results was referred to that commission;
units.label: Point 2 Part 3 Art. 35.1

units.locator: Article 35.1. Penalties for failure to comply with restrictions, prohibitions and requirements to prevent or settle conflicts of interest, and for failure to perform duties established for anti-corruption purposes
units.text: 2.1) a report by the relevant local self-government body’s personnel service unit for preventing corruption and other offences on a corruption offence, setting out its factual circumstances, and the municipal servant’s written explanation, only with their consent and provided that they acknowledge committing the corruption offence (except where the sanction is dismissal due to loss of trust);
units.label: Point 2.1 Part 3 Art. 35.1

units.locator: Article 35.1. Penalties for failure to comply with restrictions, prohibitions and requirements to prevent or settle conflicts of interest, and for failure to perform duties established for anti-corruption purposes
units.text: 3) explanations provided by the municipal servant;
units.label: Point 3 Part 3 Art. 35.1

units.locator: Article 35.1. Penalties for failure to comply with restrictions, prohibitions and requirements to prevent or settle conflicts of interest, and for failure to perform duties established for anti-corruption purposes
units.text: 4) other materials.
units.label: Point 4 Part 3 Art. 35.1

units.locator: Article 35.1. Penalties for failure to comply with restrictions, prohibitions and requirements to prevent or settle conflicts of interest, and for failure to perform duties established for anti-corruption purposes
units.text: 4. When sanctions provided for by Articles 16, 17 and 35 of this Law are imposed, account is taken of the nature and gravity of the municipal servant’s corruption offence, the circumstances in which it was committed, compliance with other restrictions, prohibitions and requirements to prevent or resolve conflicts of interest and performance of duties established for combating corruption, as well as previous results of the servant’s performance of official duties.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 35.1

units.locator: Article 35.1. Penalties for failure to comply with restrictions, prohibitions and requirements to prevent or settle conflicts of interest, and for failure to perform duties established for anti-corruption purposes
units.text: 5. An act imposing on a municipal servant sanctions provided for by Articles 16, 17 and 35 of this Law shall cite Part 1 or 2 of Article 27.1 of the Federal Law “On Municipal Service in the Russian Federation” as the ground for the sanction.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 35.1

units.locator: Article 35.1. Penalties for failure to comply with restrictions, prohibitions and requirements to prevent or settle conflicts of interest, and for failure to perform duties established for anti-corruption purposes
units.text: 6. Sanctions provided for by Articles 16, 17 and 35 of this Law are imposed no later than six months after information about the municipal servant’s corruption offence is received, excluding periods of temporary incapacity for work and leave, and no later than three years after the offence was committed. Time spent on criminal proceedings is not included in those periods.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 35.1

units.locator: Article 35.1. Penalties for failure to comply with restrictions, prohibitions and requirements to prevent or settle conflicts of interest, and for failure to perform duties established for anti-corruption purposes
units.text: 7. Information on dismissal of a municipal servant due to loss of trust is entered by the local self-government body where the servant served into the register of persons dismissed due to loss of trust provided for by Article 15 of the Federal Law “On Combating Corruption”.
units.label: Part 7 Art. 35.1
